short_summary: HealthRate is an independent platform for real-time pricing of high-cost healthcare claims, with pre-seed funding, product in production, and a $9M+ pipeline.
long_summary: HealthRate addresses price irrationality in healthcare by providing a platform that compares and procures network pricing for catastrophic claims. The company has raised $1M pre-seed, built a production product, won HIMSS Best in Show, signed its first customer, and has a $9M+ pipeline ARR. It has 87% gross margins, a structural moat due to independence, and a TAM of $500M-$1.8B. The team is led by Tim Michaels, CEO, with an experienced advisory board. Use of proceeds will focus on sales expansion, platform scaling, data ingestion, and operations.
